description:
Advances from a small village to a bustling town, ready to expand rapidly. This is the Persian town phase.
The 'Times of War' bonus dercreases the batch training time in Stables. Large batches will benefit more than small batches.
In mathematical terms: The training time of one batch gets divided by `batchSize^0.1`.
tooltip: Advance to Town Phase, unlocking new entities and technologies. Civic Centers gain +15% territory influence radius, +5 garrison capacity, +5 population capacity, +5 attack range. Garrisoned Structures gain +0.5 Capture Point regeneration.
